pairs: I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers.
You know that when you were Gentiles,
ad simulacra muta prout ducebamini euntes.
you approached mute idols, doing what you were led to do.
quod nemo in Spiritu Dei loquens, dicit anathema Jesu.
I would have you know that no one speaking in the Spirit of God utters a curse against Jesus.
Et nemo potest dicere, Dominus Jesus,
And no one is able to say that Jesus is Lord,
idem vero Deus qui operatur omnia in omnibus.
but the same God, who works everything in everyone.
Unicuique autem datur manifestatio Spiritus ad utilitatem.
However, the manifestation of the Spirit is given to each one toward what is beneficial.
Alii quidem per Spiritum datur sermo sapientiæ: alii autem sermo scientiæ secundum eumdem Spiritum:
Certainly, to one, through the Spirit, is given words of wisdom; but to another, according to the same Spirit, words of knowledge;
to another, in the same Spirit, faith;
alii gratia sanitatum in uno Spiritu:
to another, in the one Spirit, the gift of healing;
to another, miraculous works; to another,
the discernment of spirits; to another,
to another, the interpretation of words.
Hæc autem omnia operatur unus atque idem Spiritus,
But one and the same Spirit works all these things,
distributing to each one according to his will.
For just as the body is one,
omnia autem membra corporis cum sint multa,
so all the parts of the body,
Etenim in uno Spiritu omnes nos in unum corpus baptizati sumus,
we were all baptized into one body,
et omnes in uno Spiritu potati sumus.
And we all drank in the one Spirit.
Nam et corpus non est unum membrum,
For the body, too, is not one part,
If the foot were to say,
I am not of the body,”
num ideo non est de corpore?
would it then not be of the body?
And if the ear were to say,
I am not of the body,”
would it then not be of the body?
If the whole body were the eye,
But instead, God has placed the parts,
unumquodque eorum in corpore sicut voluit.
each one of them, in the body, just as it has pleased him.
Quod si essent omnia unum membrum,
So if they were all one part,
how would it be a body?
But instead, there are many parts,
Non potest autem oculus dicere manui:
And the eye cannot say to the hand,
“I have no need for your works.” And again,
the head cannot say to the feet,
“You are of no use to me.”
Sed multo magis quæ videntur membra corporis infirmiora esse,
so much more necessary are those parts of the body which seem to be weaker.
et quæ putamus ignobiliora membra esse corporis,
And though we consider certain parts of the body to be less noble,
we surround these with more abundant dignity,
those parts which are less presentable end up with more abundant respect.
our presentable parts have no such need,
since God has tempered the body together,
distributing the more abundant honor to that which has the need,
ut non sit schisma in corpore,
so that there might be no schism in the body,
sed idipsum pro invicem sollicita sint membra.
but instead the parts themselves might take care of one another.
Et si quid patitur unum membrum,
And so, if one part suffers anything,
all the parts suffer with it.
Or, if one part finds glory,
all the parts rejoice with it.
Now you are the body of Christ,
Et quosdam quidem posuit Deus in ecclesia primum apostolos,
And indeed, God has established a certain order in the Church: first Apostles,
and then the grace of healing,
of governing, of different kinds of languages,
and of the interpretation of words.
Do all have the grace of healing?
But be zealous for the better charisms.
Et adhuc excellentiorem viam vobis demonstro.
And I reveal to you a yet more excellent way.
